name: ui.components.info
purpose: Discover the official @unone/ui package name, version and whether this project declared it.
when_to_use: Before using shared components or checking a UI package version. Available without a runtime_packages declaration; see docs/ui-components.md and ui.components.create.
when_not_to_use: This reports the bundled package, not an npm registry or installed module. It does not enable a package or prove host visual support.
returns: UiComponentsInfo: {name:string, version:string, kind:string, entry:string, api:string, license:string, declared:boolean}.
frame_semantics: Does not publish UI or advance a frame. Reports the version bundled with this runtime/SDK.
